description.value: Artusi is a contemporary rustic Italian restaurant in New Westminster named after Pellegrino Artusi, the 19th-century author considered the father of modern Italian cuisine. The kitchen draws on all regions of Italy, offering handmade pasta, porchetta, and seafood dishes alongside a full drinks menu. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and the restaurant offers a takeout option for cyclists looking to eat on the move.
